testcase.name: Scenario: Stage commands for part and assembly targets from a part document: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1172:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Stage commands for part and assembly targets from a part document ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And ribbon customization is open with "All Commands" selected ✔ And the Part | Tools and Assembly | Design custom targets are empty ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part | Tools target without applying ✔ Then the Part | Tools target is marked as changed ✔ When the user selects the Assembly | Design target ✔ Then the assembly target list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Assembly | Design target ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the assembly target list ✔ And the Assembly | Design target is marked as changed ✔ When the user returns to the Part | Tools target ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains in the part target list ✔ And the Part | Tools target remains marked as changed ✔ When the user cancels customization ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the part document remains active ✔ When the user reopens customization from the Tools ribbon ✔ Then the Part | Tools target is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ When the user selects the Assembly | Design target ✔ Then the assembly target is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ Then the part document remains active
